commands.name: Ask the Business Journey Guide
commands.effect: Match one bounded capability question against the release-reviewed static journey catalog and return cited status and limitations without reading company data.

commands.name: Suggest a Business Journey
commands.effect: Creates one account-authored product suggestion after showing matching published journeys and open suggestions.

commands.name: Set a Business Journey suggestion vote
commands.effect: Sets or withdraws the confirming account's single reversible vote and derives the public count from active votes.

commands.name: Read reviewed partial commercial match
commands.effect: Derive DB1 from one confirmed partial commercial match or reproduce an exact retained revision without creating financial authority.

commands.name: Read cost query context
commands.effect: Read one admitted inventory or contribution scope with exact retained cutoffs and explicit current or historical freshness; no global generation claim.

commands.name: Propose a drafted cost review
commands.effect: Draft the review again from held records and create one proposal for it; a company owner confirms it in Decisions. Nothing else changes.

commands.name: Record the company as its business partner
commands.effect: Propose recording the company itself as a business partner with the role company, named as the company; a company owner confirms it in Decisions and only then is the partner recorded.

commands.name: Draft a cost review
commands.effect: Draft the inventory or contribution review the held records support, or name the inputs a person must provide; nothing is stored or proposed.

commands.name: Inspect retained cost record
commands.effect: Inspect retained evidence and decision fields with tenant-safe source links and paged exact membership; no current valuation claim or business writes.

commands.name: Read reviewed commercial contribution
commands.effect: Derive confirmed whole-line DB1 and independently reviewed DB2, or reproduce their exact retained historical basis.

commands.name: Preview current contribution candidate
commands.effect: Follow an exact whole invoice/order/shipment scope to received net revenue and reviewed consumption; show known DB1 only, with missing commercial review and selling costs.

commands.name: Read reviewed inventory acquisition costs
commands.effect: Derive stock acquisition value and consumption from a bounded confirmed ownership/policy scope, and derive a separate carrying value only from an exact source-backed retained assessment.

commands.name: Read received acquisition-cost evidence
commands.effect: Derive receipt costs from exact received amounts and explicit owner decisions; retain sealed reviewed knowledge and keep incomplete costs unknown.

commands.name: Read receipt acquisition costs
commands.effect: Derive receipt costs from exact received amounts and explicit owner decisions; retain sealed reviewed knowledge and keep incomplete costs unknown.

commands.name: Confirm cost and contribution decision
commands.effect: Derive receipt costs from exact received amounts and explicit owner decisions; retain sealed reviewed knowledge and keep incomplete costs unknown.

commands.name: Change Private Graph Report
commands.effect: Save, rename, duplicate or delete the authenticated user's private graph question, recording the model version that gave it meaning, with revision and retry protection.

commands.name: List Targets
commands.effect: Maintain and explain explicit external destinations without changing financial evidence.

commands.name: List Target References
commands.effect: Maintain and explain explicit external destinations without changing financial evidence.

commands.name: List Mappings
commands.effect: Maintain and explain explicit external destinations without changing financial evidence.

commands.name: Mapping History
commands.effect: Maintain and explain explicit external destinations without changing financial evidence.

commands.name: Preview Document
commands.effect: Maintain and explain explicit external destinations without changing financial evidence.

commands.name: Maintain Target Configuration
commands.effect: Maintain and explain explicit external destinations without changing financial evidence.

commands.name: Read source code mappings
commands.effect: Resolve explicit source codes with reviewed immutable classification revisions; never change received evidence or postings.

commands.name: Read source mapping history
commands.effect: Resolve explicit source codes with reviewed immutable classification revisions; never change received evidence or postings.

commands.name: Set source code mapping
commands.effect: Resolve explicit source codes with reviewed immutable classification revisions; never change received evidence or postings.

commands.name: Read received financial detail
commands.effect: Separate received values from owner-confirmed internal classification and exact cost-center shares; preserve postings.

commands.name: Read component assignment history
commands.effect: Separate received values from owner-confirmed internal classification and exact cost-center shares; preserve postings.

commands.name: Assign received financial component
commands.effect: Separate received values from owner-confirmed internal classification and exact cost-center shares; preserve postings.

commands.name: Read finance references
commands.effect: Read or maintain defined internal references with immutable reasoned decisions and owner confirmation for changes.

commands.name: Read reference history
commands.effect: Read or maintain defined internal references with immutable reasoned decisions and owner confirmation for changes.

commands.name: Maintain finance reference
commands.effect: Read or maintain defined internal references with immutable reasoned decisions and owner confirmation for changes.

commands.name: Initialize operational accounts
commands.effect: Uses shared tenant-scoped operational account configuration with explicit owner confirmation for changes.

commands.name: Create operational account
commands.effect: Uses shared tenant-scoped operational account configuration with explicit owner confirmation for changes.

commands.name: Update operational account
commands.effect: Uses shared tenant-scoped operational account configuration with explicit owner confirmation for changes.

commands.name: Set operational account default
commands.effect: Uses shared tenant-scoped operational account configuration with explicit owner confirmation for changes.

commands.name: Read operational transaction matrix
commands.effect: Describes configured defaults and fixed operation roles; no posting or authorization.

commands.name: Read operational accounts
commands.effect: Uses shared tenant-scoped operational account configuration with explicit owner confirmation for changes.

commands.name: Observe fact
commands.effect: Appends one idempotent source-supported observation about an existing tenant-scoped subject after confirmation without copying typed operational state.

commands.name: Create manual sales or purchase order
commands.effect: Atomically records lossless manual Source evidence, typed order Evidence, and the derived outgoing or incoming Commitments without storing operational status on the Document.

commands.name: Install mock connector shell
commands.effect: Creates one named source instance with only explicitly selected source and target type declarations, without credentials, synchronization, or vendor API calls.

commands.name: Define source system
commands.effect: Defines one tenant-specific external origin without pretending that a connector or credentials already exist.

commands.name: Define source capability
commands.effect: Declares which upstream type a source may provide and the operational target it is intended to produce.

commands.name: Ingest arbitrary source
commands.effect: Stores any JSON object losslessly and idempotently, then queues a registered interpreter or marks the job unmapped.

commands.name: Correct manual document evidence
commands.effect: Corrects typed internal header or complete line evidence snapshots while protecting economic fields after Reality records have been derived.

commands.name: Record corrected document source
commands.effect: Appends a lossless immutable version to the original source stream and queues normal interpretation.

commands.name: Create party
commands.effect: Creates a tenant-scoped party, optional immutable source evidence, operational roles, and exact correspondence addresses.

commands.name: Update party
commands.effect: Changes operational party fields, roles and exact correspondence addresses; changed external identity creates new source evidence and every effective change emits an exact before/after audit diff.

commands.name: Create item
commands.effect: Creates an operational item identity with inventory and purchasing behavior.

commands.name: Update item
commands.effect: Updates operational item fields while preserving external evidence versions and emitting an exact before/after audit diff.

commands.name: Create location
commands.effect: Creates a stock-capable or logical location and validates its parent.

commands.name: Update location
commands.effect: Updates location behavior, rejects hierarchy cycles, and emits an exact before/after audit diff.

commands.name: Create handling unit
commands.effect: Records an optional tenant-scoped pallet identity with an optional NVE/SSCC and immutable source evidence.

commands.name: Create lot
commands.effect: Creates a tenant-scoped batch identity for a lot- or serial-tracked item without storing a stock balance.

commands.name: State lot expiry
commands.effect: Records the best-before date somebody read off the goods; refuses a different date, because a received value is not adjusted.

commands.name: Correct lot expiry
commands.effect: Records that a stated best-before was read wrong and what it says instead, against a confirmed current value and a stated reason.

commands.name: Read expired lots
commands.effect: Lists lots whose stated best-before has passed, oldest first; a lot with no stated date is absent in both directions.

commands.name: Create serial unit
commands.effect: Creates the identity of one serialized unit, optionally linked to its lot, without storing its location or status.

commands.name: Change master-data lifecycle
commands.effect: Activates or deactivates master data without deleting historical relationships.

commands.name: Create payment term
commands.effect: Creates a reusable payment condition identified by an opaque ID.

commands.name: Create price list
commands.effect: Creates a sales or purchase list and enforces one active default per direction and currency.

commands.name: Add price tier
commands.effect: Adds an item price selected from an inclusive minimum quantity.

commands.name: Assign party price list
commands.effect: Gives a customer or supplier a directly prioritized price list.

commands.name: Resolve authoritative price quote
commands.effect: Selects the currently applicable quantity tier and exposes the direct, group, or default assignment path without copying a price.

commands.name: Create and assign pricing group
commands.effect: Builds reusable customer or supplier group pricing without copying prices onto parties.

commands.name: Reserve stock
commands.effect: Allocates available stock to one commitment, optionally by pallet, lot, or exact serial unit, and reports any shortage.

commands.name: Release reservation
commands.effect: Gives reserved stock back to whatever needs it next, without touching the promise that held it.

commands.name: Record movement
commands.effect: Records an immutable physical event with the same optional pallet, lot, and serial identity used by reservations.

commands.name: Correct movement
commands.effect: Preserves an immutable original, appends one exact correction and optional replacement, and derives the auditable net physical effect.

commands.name: Reverse ledger posting group
commands.effect: Preserves one complete immutable posting group, appends its exact inverse, and derives corrected settlement and financial views.

commands.name: Revise commitment
commands.effect: Records that a counterparty now states a different date, a different quantity, or both for a promise, without erasing what it replaces.

commands.name: Cancel commitment remainder
commands.effect: Cancels only the open remainder for an explicit reason while retaining fulfilment history and releasing active reservations and holds.

commands.name: Hold commitment
commands.effect: Prevents execution without changing or deleting the underlying obligation.

commands.name: Hold document commitments
commands.effect: Places individual holds on the open commitments evidenced by a document.

commands.name: Set party delivery hold
commands.effect: Blocks customer shipment execution while orders and reservations remain possible.

commands.name: Release a credit hold
commands.effect: Lifts only an order's credit holds with a stated reason, confirmed by a company owner; other holds stay.

commands.name: Block stock
commands.effect: Holds back a quantity where it lies with a reason; nothing moves, and it is excluded from availability, reservation and shipping.

commands.name: Release a stock block
commands.effect: Makes blocked stock available again, wholly or partly, with the reason; nothing moves.

commands.name: Scrap blocked stock
commands.effect: Writes blocked stock off its location, wholly or partly, with one reasoned adjustment linked to the block.

commands.name: Serve backorders
commands.effect: Reserves available stock for waiting customer orders in the serving order (assigned to the received purchase first, then by due date), as a person confirmed it.

commands.name: Read available to promise
commands.effect: Answers from when and how much of an item can be promised, naming each open purchase and its date.

commands.name: State the company currency
commands.effect: States the currency the company keeps its books in, as a new version of the company's currency statement; refused once the company has posted anything.

commands.name: Read the company currency
commands.effect: Answers the company currency, EUR until stated, and whether the company has posted anything.

commands.name: State supplier item terms
commands.effect: States a supplier's minimum order quantity and order multiple for an item, as a new version of their statement stream; purchase reviews name an order that falls short.

commands.name: Withdraw supplier item terms
commands.effect: Withdraws a supplier's minimum order quantity and order multiple for an item.

commands.name: Read supplier item terms
commands.effect: Lists suppliers' minimum order quantities and order multiples, of one supplier or one item.

commands.name: Define a kit
commands.effect: States the components of a kit once, with how many one kit takes and optionally each component's share of the kit's price.

commands.name: Assemble kits
commands.effect: Consumes every component and produces whole kits at one location under one assembly statement, all or nothing; a component short of free stock refuses the whole assembly.

commands.name: Read kits
commands.effect: Lists the kits with their components and, per location, the free kits on hand, the whole kits the free components build and the component that limits them.

commands.name: Read a kit line's split
commands.effect: Splits a kit line's stated gross, net and tax across the components by the stated shares, adding up exactly to the line.

commands.name: Read the three-way match of a purchase order
commands.effect: Answers per purchase line whether the quantity in force was received and billed at the agreed price, or names each difference.

commands.name: State a customer item number
commands.effect: States which of our items a customer's own article number names, with the customer's name for it, as a new version of that number's statement stream.

commands.name: Withdraw a customer item number
commands.effect: Withdraws a customer's article number; lines ordered by it keep it as stated.

commands.name: Read customer item numbers
commands.effect: Lists a customer's own article numbers, or the numbers customers use for one item.

commands.name: Plan an outbound delivery
commands.effect: Plans one delivery of a customer's open promises before dispatch, with its recipient, stated address, booked slot and staging location; a promise can be split across deliveries up to what is still open.

commands.name: Revise a planned delivery
commands.effect: States a planned delivery anew before it ships, such as a changed address or a promise that rides along; every statement is kept as a version.

commands.name: Pick a planned delivery
commands.effect: Transfers goods from where a promise is reserved into the delivery's staging location; the reservation moves with them, so availability stays true.

commands.name: Put back picked goods
commands.effect: Transfers picked goods out of staging to a stock location; an open promise's reservation moves back with them.

commands.name: Read planned deliveries
commands.effect: Lists the planned deliveries, newest first, with recipient, address, slot, derived state and per line planned, picked, to put back and shipped.

commands.name: Read a planned delivery
commands.effect: Shows one planned delivery with its pick and put-back movements, every statement, its shipment and the dispatch arguments that ship exactly what it carries.

commands.name: Record a stock count
commands.effect: Records what was counted at a location and posts each difference against the book at its counting time as an adjustment; a loss comes off free stock first, then the location's blocks.

commands.name: Read stock counts
commands.effect: Lists the counts of a location or of the company, newest first.

commands.name: Read a stock count
commands.effect: Shows one count with each line as counted, the book at its counting time, and the adjustments that posted it.

commands.name: State a delivery rule
commands.effect: States how a customer or one order is delivered (partial allowed, ship complete or no backorders) with its reason, as a new version of the subject's statement stream.

commands.name: Read delivery rules
commands.effect: Shows the delivery rule in force for a customer or an order, where it comes from, and every earlier statement.

commands.name: Read stock blocks
commands.effect: Lists the stock held back by blocks with item, location, identity, quantity, reason and who blocked it.

commands.name: Set a reorder point
commands.effect: States or restates the stock level at which an item is reordered at a location and the quantity then ordered, refusing a change since the review.

commands.name: Remove a reorder point
commands.effect: Withdraws an item's reorder point at a location; the event keeps the values it had.

commands.name: Read reorder points
commands.effect: Lists the reorder points the company stated, per item and location, in the item's stock unit.

commands.name: Read a credit exposure
commands.effect: Derives a customer's exposure against its credit limit, open invoices plus open uninvoiced orders minus available credits, naming overdue invoices and payables.

commands.name: Record a down-payment invoice
commands.effect: Records and posts a down-payment invoice for a sales order, a receivable against received down payments that bills no quantity and counts towards prepayment once paid.

commands.name: Record a pro-forma invoice
commands.effect: Records a pro-forma invoice for a sales order as evidence only; it posts nothing, is no open item and bills no quantity.

commands.name: Read the month-end billing lists
commands.effect: Lists order lines shipped and not invoiced, and invoiced and not shipped, from the findings at one instant.

commands.name: Post customer payment
commands.effect: Records payment evidence, posts balanced ledger entries, and allocates the payment to an invoice.

commands.name: Announce customer return
commands.effect: Records that a customer says goods are coming back, bounded by what the delivery can still return.

commands.name: Withdraw return announcement
commands.effect: Records that the customer is not sending the goods back after all, keeping what they announced.

commands.name: Read announced returns
commands.effect: Lists the returns customers have announced, in the order they said so, with what is still expected.

commands.name: Preview payment run
commands.effect: Shows which supplier invoices are worth paying now, what each supplier is owed, and what was withheld, without paying anything.

commands.name: Execute payment run
commands.effect: Pays the supplier invoices and amounts somebody confirmed, in one transaction, and records that they were one decision.

commands.name: Preview stale promise closure
commands.effect: Shows how many stale promises match, what would be released, and a bounded sample, without changing anything.

commands.name: Close stale promises
commands.effect: Closes the promises somebody previewed and counted, releasing their reservations and recording the reason once.

commands.name: Record manual document
commands.effect: Records normalized document evidence and its lines without booking anything or creating a promise.

commands.name: Post sales invoice
commands.effect: Books a recorded sales invoice, so what the customer owes becomes visible to settlement and the queue.

commands.name: Post supplier invoice
commands.effect: Books a recorded supplier invoice, so what the company owes becomes visible to settlement and the queue.

commands.name: Record return credit
commands.effect: Records a stated invoice-linked customer credit with explicit optional netting, or legacy return credit through an order line; no refund or stock movement.

commands.name: Record supplier invoice
commands.effect: Records stated supplier invoice evidence linked to one or more purchase order lines of one supplier and posts its payable atomically.

commands.name: Record free supplier invoice
commands.effect: Records stated supplier invoice evidence without a purchase-order line and posts its payable atomically without inventing a commitment or Movement.

commands.name: Read invoice credit context
commands.effect: Shows exact customer-invoice positions and remaining credit capacity without recording a credit.

commands.name: Read billable invoice positions
commands.effect: Lists one party's delivered or received order positions not yet fully billed, grouped by order, without recording an invoice.

commands.name: Read dunning context
commands.effect: Validates one selected reminder scope and returns the finance revision without recording or sending anything.

commands.name: List dunning notices
commands.effect: Lists retained manual reminders with their invoice membership, optional fee and reversal trace.

commands.name: Read dunning notice
commands.effect: Reads one retained manual reminder with its exact invoice membership, optional fee and reversal trace.

commands.name: Record dunning notice
commands.effect: Records one explicitly reviewed manual reminder and optional exact stated fee without sending a message.

commands.name: Reverse dunning notice
commands.effect: Retains the original reminder and explicitly reverses its fee effect and reminder state.

commands.name: Read dunning schedule
commands.effect: Reads the company's waiting days and fixed fee for dunning levels 1 to 3.

commands.name: Set dunning schedule
commands.effect: Replaces the company's three dunning levels with the confirmed waiting days and fees; recorded notices keep theirs.

commands.name: Preview dunning run
commands.effect: Proposes notices per customer, currency and level for overdue items and names items waiting, with credit or in collection, without recording anything.

commands.name: Confirm dunning run
commands.effect: Records the reviewed notices still due at their reviewed level and names every skipped item, in one transaction, without sending anything.

commands.name: Hand over to collection
commands.effect: Hands one customer's level-3 invoices to collection with a reason and places a delivery hold with the reason collection.

commands.name: Record a returned payment
commands.effect: Reverses a returned customer payment so its invoices are open again, keeps the stated kind, reason and reference, and books a stated fee as expense or charges it to the customer.

commands.name: List returned payments
commands.effect: Lists returned direct debits and chargebacks with their reason, fee and reopened invoices.

commands.name: Read a returned payment
commands.effect: Reads one returned payment with its reason, reference, fee and reopened invoices.

commands.name: Settle a payout
commands.effect: Books a stated marketplace or provider payout line by line on the provider's cash account (payments, refunds against credit notes, chargebacks, fees), moves the net payout to the bank and leaves lines that lead nowhere unbooked.

commands.name: List payouts
commands.effect: Lists payouts with their net amount and the lines nothing booked yet.

commands.name: Read a payout
commands.effect: Reads one payout with every stated line, what it booked, the invoices it settled and the shipment a tracking number names.

commands.name: Record a payment authorization
commands.effect: Records what a card or wallet provider authorized for one sales order, until when.

commands.name: Record a payment capture
commands.effect: Records an amount captured against an authorization, never more than is left and not after it lapsed.

commands.name: List payment authorizations
commands.effect: Lists authorizations with what was captured, what is left and whether each is live, expired or captured.

commands.name: List collection handovers
commands.effect: Lists collection handovers with their invoices and delivery hold.

commands.name: Read collection handover
commands.effect: Reads one collection handover with its invoices, last notices and delivery hold.

commands.name: Record sales invoice
commands.effect: Records a stated invoice against one or more order lines of one customer and posts its receivable atomically.

commands.name: Post credit note
commands.effect: Posts a credit note as the exact reverse of a sales invoice, leaving the customer owed what it states.

commands.name: Net credit note against invoice
commands.effect: Settles a posted credit note against an invoice the same customer still owes.

commands.name: Post customer refund
commands.effect: Returns money to a credited customer and settles the credit note it repays.

commands.name: Post supplier credit note
commands.effect: Books a credit a supplier sent as the exact reverse of its invoice, leaving the supplier owing what it states.

commands.name: Net supplier credit against invoice
commands.effect: Settles a booked supplier credit against an invoice the company still owes that supplier.

commands.name: Post supplier refund
commands.effect: Takes money back from a supplier and settles the credit note it repays.

commands.name: Post supplier payment
commands.effect: Records an outgoing payment and explicitly settles a supplier invoice entry.

commands.name: Invite company member
commands.effect: Creates an owner-authorized company invitation and atomically queues its first delivery.

commands.name: Resend company invitation
commands.effect: Invalidates older delivery generations and queues a fresh invitation delivery after owner reauthorization.

commands.name: Revoke company invitation
commands.effect: Revokes a pending invitation after owner reauthorization.

commands.name: Remove company member
commands.effect: Archives a non-owner company membership after owner reauthorization.

commands.name: Read settlement reduction context
commands.effect: Reads the remaining claim and permitted noncash counterpart.

commands.name: Accept settlement reduction
commands.effect: Creates a separately evidenced noncash reduction only with explicit owner confirmation.

commands.name: Read payment and credit context
commands.effect: Reads the selected invoice or available credit and matching invoice choices.

commands.name: Record payment or use existing credit
commands.effect: Atomically records stated cash, explicit allocation and optional reduction, or consumes existing credit after owner confirmation.

commands.name: Read opening position context
commands.effect: Reads permitted opening counterpart, tenant parties and confirmation revision.

commands.name: Import opening positions
commands.effect: Records stated residual customer/supplier positions against a neutral counterpart after owner confirmation, without cash or turnover.

commands.name: Record shipment notice
commands.effect: Records a stated consignment and package without moving stock.

commands.name: Dispatch or receive shipment package
commands.effect: Atomically records one physical package and its exact existing Movement effects.

commands.name: Record shipment event
commands.effect: Appends one attributed logistics observation without changing stock.

commands.name: Supersede shipment event
commands.effect: Appends a reasoned correction or retraction without deleting the original event.

commands.name: Assign incoming supply to customer demand
commands.effect: Assigns an explicit quantity of an incoming supplier commitment to a compatible customer commitment without moving or reserving stock.

commands.name: Exchange returned goods for a replacement
commands.effect: Settles part of a customer return with a free replacement delivery to the same customer instead of a credit; no money moves.

commands.name: Record a failed delivery
commands.effect: Records that a customer shipment came back undeliverable, was refused or was lost; reverses its movements so the promise is open again, brings the goods back or writes them off, and may open a carrier claim.

commands.name: Record a drop shipment
commands.effect: Records that a supplier shipped an assigned purchase straight to the customer; keeps the purchase and the customer promise with one receipt and one shipment that pass none of the company's locations, so stock is untouched.

commands.name: Assign an item to an order line
commands.effect: Gives a sales-order line whose stated SKU matched no item the item the shop meant and creates its delivery promise from the order; no money moves.

commands.name: Resolve arrived customer-return goods
commands.effect: Records one explicit physical outcome for part or all of an arrived customer return without implying a credit.

Set or release party delivery hold
